"""Carry an existing watershed report into the same-cohort GIS map release."""
from __future__ import annotations

from .common import (INVEST_VERSION, atomic_json, describe_file, digest,
                     identifier, read_json)
from .model_selection import run_scope
from .reuse import copy_verified

SCHEMA = "upstate.report-release/v1"


def _cohort(workspace, report_id, *, packet=None):
    from . import scenario_decisions

    report_id = identifier(report_id)
    if packet is None:
        packet = scenario_decisions.inspect(workspace, report_id, include_report=True)
    summary, report = packet["summary"], packet["report"]
    if report.get("project", {}).get("id") != workspace.project["id"]:
        raise ValueError("Open this watershed report in its original project")
    selected = report.get("selection", {})
    if digest(selected) != digest(summary.get("selection")):
        raise ValueError("The saved report and its original selection differ")
    ids = selected.get("run_ids")
    if (not isinstance(ids, list) or not ids or len(set(ids)) != len(ids)
            or report.get("baseline_run_id") != ids[0]
            or summary.get("baseline_run_id") != ids[0]):
        raise ValueError("Retain the report's complete ordered run selection")
    ids = [identifier(value) for value in ids]
    details = report.get("runs", [])
    if [item.get("id") for item in details] != ids:
        raise ValueError("The saved report's native run cohort differs")

    problems, cases = [], []
    grid_id = details[0]["selection"]["grid_id"]
    profile_id = details[0]["selection"]["profile_id"]

    def issue(code, message, run_id=None):
        problems.append({"code": code, "message": message, "run_id": run_id})

    if len(ids) == 1:
        issue("future_scenario",
              "This report contains the reference only. Complete a land-cover alternative "
              "and save a report containing that reference and the alternative.")

    for index, detail in enumerate(details):
        run_id = detail["id"]
        case = {"id": run_id, "title": detail.get("scenario_title", run_id),
                "role": "reference" if index == 0 else "alternative",
                "profile_id": detail["selection"]["profile_id"],
                "grid_id": detail["selection"]["grid_id"],
                "scenario_kind": detail.get("scenario_kind"),
                "comparison_kind": detail.get("comparison_kind")}
        cases.append(case)
        try:
            run = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
            if digest(run["selection"]) != digest(detail["selection"]):
                issue("run_selection", "Restore the exact native selection saved by this report.", run_id)
            scope = run_scope(run)
            if not scope["full_model_outputs"]:
                missing = [name.upper() for name in ("ndr", "sdr")
                           if name not in scope["completed_models"]]
                issue("native_models",
                      "Complete " + (", ".join(missing) or "the selected native stages")
                      + " for " + case["title"] + " before building the seven-map release.", run_id)
            if run.get("runtime", {}).get("version") != INVEST_VERSION:
                issue("native_version",
                      "Use the original InVEST " + INVEST_VERSION + " outputs for " + case["title"] + ".", run_id)
            if run["selection"]["grid_id"] != grid_id:
                issue("grid", "Use the reference grid for every map-release alternative.", run_id)
            if run["selection"]["profile_id"] != profile_id:
                issue("profile",
                      case["title"] + " uses a different parameter profile. Save a common-profile "
                      "land-cover report for the map release; this sensitivity report remains available.", run_id)
            scenario = workspace._get("scenarios", run["selection"]["scenario_id"])
            expected_kind = "baseline" if index == 0 else "landcover"
            if scenario["kind"] != expected_kind:
                issue("scenario_kind",
                      ("Choose an original baseline as the report's first run." if index == 0 else
                       case["title"] + " must contain explicit land-cover changes for the future-service maps."),
                      run_id)
        except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            issue("native_run", "Reopen or restore " + case["title"] + ": " + str(error), run_id)

    binding = {
        "schema": SCHEMA,
        "report_id": report_id,
        "report_sha256": summary["files"]["json"]["sha256"],
        "report_title": report["title"],
        "report_created_at": report["created_at"],
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
        "baseline_run_id": ids[0],
        "scenario_run_ids": ids[1:],
        "grid_id": grid_id,
        "profile_id": profile_id,
        "pollutants": report.get("pollutants", []),
        "report_kind": report.get("report_kind"),
        "zones": [{"id": zone["id"], "title": zone["title"], "scope": zone["scope"]}
                  for zone in report.get("zones", [])],
        "source_files": summary["files"],
    }
    selection = {
        "source_report_id": report_id,
        "source_report_sha256": binding["report_sha256"],
        "baseline_run_id": ids[0],
        "scenario_run_ids": list(ids[1:]),
        "title": report["title"],
    }
    return packet, binding, selection, cases, problems


def _releases(workspace, report_id, report_sha256):
    result, issues = [], []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "deliveries").glob("*/delivery-state.json")):
        try:
            value = read_json(path)
            selection = value.get("selection", {})
            if selection.get("source_report_id") != report_id:
                continue
            if value.get("schema") != "upstate.delivery/v1" or value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
                raise ValueError("Original release identity differs")
            if selection.get("source_report_sha256") != report_sha256:
                raise ValueError("Release refers to a different report edition")
            result.append({
                "id": value["id"],
                "title": selection.get("title") or value["id"],
                "state": value.get("state"),
                "created_at": value.get("created_at"),
                "completed_at": value.get("completed_at"),
                "baseline_run_id": selection.get("baseline_run_id"),
                "scenario_run_ids": selection.get("scenario_run_ids", []),
                "files": sorted(value.get("files", {})),
            })
        except (ValueError, OSError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            issues.append({"release_id": path.parent.name, "message": str(error)})
    result.sort(key=lambda row: (row.get("created_at") or "", row["id"]), reverse=True)
    return result, issues


def describe(workspace, report_id, *, packet=None):
    """Read saved products and original selections; never rerun a calculation."""
    _, binding, selection, cases, issues = _cohort(workspace, report_id, packet=packet)
    releases, release_issues = _releases(workspace, binding["report_id"], binding["report_sha256"])
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA,
        "source_report": binding,
        "selection": selection,
        "ready": not issues,
        "cases": cases,
        "issues": issues,
        "releases": releases,
        "release_issues": release_issues,
        "remaining_choices": [
            "Original source-water and high-quality-water overlays",
            "Responsible GIS metadata contact",
            "Map layout and any explicit priority settings",
        ],
    }


def bind_report(workspace, selection):
    """Validate a requested report link before it contributes to release identity.

    Return the exact retained binding, or None for an ordinary unlinked release.
    The caller retains report_sha256 in selection before computing its release ID.
    """
    report_id = selection.get("source_report_id")
    if report_id is None:
        if selection.get("source_report_sha256") is not None:
            raise ValueError("Choose the original watershed report for this report edition")
        return None
    _, binding, requested, _, issues = _cohort(workspace, report_id)
    expected_hash = selection.get("source_report_sha256")
    if expected_hash is not None and expected_hash != binding["report_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The saved watershed report edition changed; reopen its release selection")
    if selection.get("baseline_run_id") != requested["baseline_run_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Keep the saved report's exact reference when linking its map release")
    if selection.get("scenario_run_ids") != requested["scenario_run_ids"]:
        raise ValueError("Keep every saved report alternative in its original order, "
                         "or explicitly start an independent map release")
    if issues:
        raise ValueError(" ".join(item["message"] for item in issues))
    return binding


def retain_report(workspace, directory, state, binding):
    """Copy the original report and its tables into the normal GIS package inputs."""
    if binding is None:
        return []
    from . import scenario_decisions

    packet = scenario_decisions.inspect(workspace, binding["report_id"], include_report=False)
    summary = packet["summary"]
    if summary["files"]["json"]["sha256"] != binding["report_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The selected watershed report changed before release packaging")
    source = workspace.root / "scenario-decisions" / binding["report_id"]
    prefix = "reports/" + binding["report_id"] + "/"
    files = state.setdefault("files", {})
    retained = []
    for name, descriptor in summary["files"].items():
        key = "source_report_" + name
        copied = copy_verified(source, descriptor, directory,
                               path=prefix + descriptor["path"])
        if key in files and files[key]["sha256"] != copied["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("The retained release report member differs: " + name)
        files[key] = {**copied, "title": binding["report_title"] + " / " + name,
                      "report_id": binding["report_id"]}
        retained.append(copied["path"])

    original = describe_file(source, source / "decision.json")
    copied = copy_verified(source, original, directory, path=prefix + "decision.json")
    files["source_report_record"] = {**copied, "report_id": binding["report_id"]}
    retained.append(copied["path"])
    link_path = directory / "source-report.json"
    atomic_json(link_path, binding, immutable=True)
    files["source_report_link"] = describe_file(directory, link_path,
                                              title="Original watershed report selection")
    retained.append(files["source_report_link"]["path"])
    state["source_report"] = binding
    return retained

operator/REPORT_MAP_RELEASES.md.content:
# Watershed report to map release

Open **Watershed reports**, select a saved report, and choose **Build map release**. The atlas desk receives the original reference, every alternative in its saved order, the report title, and the exact saved report edition.

Complete the original source-water and high-quality-water overlay choices, the responsible GIS metadata contact, and the map layout. Build the release through the existing task queue. Open the resulting atlas, individual maps, technical report and GIS package from the same retained release.

The saved watershed report shows its associated releases and their current state. **Open release** returns to the retained map products. The atlas can open the source watershed report through the same extension host. Reopening the project or restoring its working archive retains these links and the original project identity.

## Use a scientifically compatible report

A seven-map release uses an original baseline and one or more explicit land-cover alternatives, with completed native NDR and SDR outputs on one grid and one parameter profile.

The report panel identifies the particular case that needs attention when the saved report contains a reference alone, an unfinished native model, a parameter-sensitivity alternative, or a different grid. Keep the scientific comparison you already saved and create the appropriate report from the completed common-profile cases.

The builder preserves every selected alternative. Changing the reference or alternatives is an explicit independent release; remove the source-report link in the atlas before changing that cohort. A linked release records the original report SHA-256 before assigning its release identity.

## Original report products in the release

The normal release package includes a reports directory containing the source report JSON, its offline HTML, annual totals, comparison CSV, watershed GeoJSON and original decision record. The source-report.json file identifies the source edition, cases, grid, profile and watershed selections. These are the original saved products; opening or packaging them does not repeat the native calculation or watershed aggregation.

The standard delivery manifest lists these files with the other project assets. The normal workspace archive and receiving workflow carry the same source report and relationship.

## Integration contracts

- The scenario-reports extension exposes GET /api/scenario-reports/release?report_id=ID through the existing authenticated operator. Its response contains ready, selection, cases, issues, releases and source_report.
- The existing report response includes the same release context.
- The browser bridge invokes openExtension('map-atlas', 'create', {workspace_key, selection}) and openExtension('map-atlas', 'open', releaseId, {workspace_key}).
- The report controller exposes open(reportId, {workspace_key}) for the reverse link and retains the request through navigation into a previously unmounted desk. Navigation failures clear that request, and changing projects cancels it before the other workspace loads.
- model.report_release.bind_report(workspace, selection) checks the saved cohort before release identity is computed. The returned report_sha256 is retained as selection.source_report_sha256.
- model.report_release.retain_report(workspace, directory, state, binding) carries original products into the normal delivery file catalogue. Its source_report_ entries are included in the manifest project_assets.

model/map_atlas.py.content:
"""Ordered seven-family map atlas from the existing delivery's native map panels."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import math
from pathlib import Path
import textwrap

from .common import MAP_IDS, atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, finite, verify_file
from . import cartography

ATLAS_VERSION = "seven-family-atlas/v1"
PAPER = {"letter": (11.0, 8.5), "a4": (297 / 25.4, 210 / 25.4),
         "a3": (420 / 25.4, 297 / 25.4)}
INDEX_ROWS = 14
FILE_KEYS = ("map_atlas", "map_atlas_index", "map_atlas_csv")


def _text(value, label, limit, *, default=""):
    value = default if value is None else value
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(label + " must be text")
    value = " ".join(value.split())
    if len(value) > limit:
        raise ValueError(label + " must contain at most " + str(limit) + " characters")
    return value


def settings(value=None):
    """Validate print settings without changing the analytical priority settings."""
    value = {} if value is None else value
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("Map settings must be an object")
    paper = value.get("paper", "a4")
    if paper not in PAPER:
        raise ValueError("Choose Letter, A4 or A3 landscape paper")
    raw_dpi = value.get("dpi", 220)
    dpi = finite(raw_dpi, "Map DPI", minimum=120)
    if isinstance(raw_dpi, bool) or dpi != int(dpi) or dpi > 600:
        raise ValueError("Choose a whole-number map DPI from 120 to 600")
    percentile = finite(value.get("display_percentile", 98),
                        "Map display percentile", minimum=0)
    if percentile > 100:
        raise ValueError("Map display percentile must be at most 100")
    titles = value.get("family_titles", {})
    if not isinstance(titles, dict) or set(titles) - set(MAP_IDS):
        raise ValueError("Family titles must use the seven original map-family identifiers")
    return {
        "paper": paper, "dpi": int(dpi), "display_percentile": percentile,
        "title": _text(value.get("title"), "Atlas title", 140),
        "subtitle": _text(value.get("subtitle"), "Atlas subtitle", 220),
        "family_titles": {key: _text(title, "Map-family title", 110)
                          for key, title in titles.items() if title},
    }


def _sheet(plt, options, title, page_number, page_count):
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=PAPER[options["paper"]])
    fig.text(.07, .945, title, fontsize=16, weight="semibold", va="top")
    fig.text(.07, .045, "Upper Savannah Scientific Workbench", fontsize=7, color="#444444")
    fig.text(.93, .045, str(page_number) + " / " + str(page_count),
             fontsize=7, ha="right", color="#444444")
    return fig


def _wrap(value, width):
    return "\n".join(textwrap.wrap(str(value), width, break_long_words=False,
                                   break_on_hyphens=False))


def _intro(pdf, plt, options, rows, *, title, selection, grid, footer, page_count):
    fig = _sheet(plt, options, "Watershed map atlas", 1, page_count)
    try:
        fig.text(.07, .80, _wrap(title, 64), fontsize=21, va="top")
        if options["subtitle"]:
            fig.text(.07, .65, _wrap(options["subtitle"], 110), fontsize=10, va="top")
        fig.text(.07, .54, "Seven map families  ·  " + str(len(rows)) + " map sheets",
                 fontsize=11, va="top")
        contact = selection["contact"]
        fig.text(.07, .48, _wrap(contact["name"] + " · " + contact["organization"], 110),
                 fontsize=9, va="top")
        fig.text(.07, .44, contact["email"], fontsize=9, va="top")
        methodology = (
            "Current nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment sheets use the retained native export values. "
            "Future sheets show each named alternative minus its baseline. Shared pollutant scales "
            "retain the same numerical meaning across every alternative. The combined priority is "
            "the recorded dimensionless decision index."
        )
        fig.text(.07, .34, _wrap(methodology, 130), fontsize=9, va="top", linespacing=1.5)
        fig.text(.07, .19, _wrap(footer, 145), fontsize=8, va="top")
        fig.text(.07, .11, "Grid " + grid["id"][:16] + " · baseline " +
                 selection["baseline_run_id"][:16] + " · " +
                 options["paper"].upper() + " landscape · " + str(options["dpi"]) + " DPI",
                 fontsize=7, va="top")
        pdf.savefig(fig, dpi=options["dpi"])
    finally:
        plt.close(fig)

    chunks = [rows[start:start + INDEX_ROWS] for start in range(0, len(rows), INDEX_ROWS)]
    for number, chunk in enumerate(chunks, 2):
        fig = _sheet(plt, options, "Map contents", number, page_count)
        try:
            fig.text(.07, .86, "FAMILY / MAP", fontsize=8, color="#555555")
            fig.text(.93, .86, "PAGE", fontsize=8, color="#555555", ha="right")
            for i, row in enumerate(chunk):
                y = .81 - i * .050
                heading = str(MAP_IDS.index(row["family"]) + 1) + ". " + row["title"]
                # The complete subtitle and identifiers are retained in the index files.
                if row["scenario_run_id"]:
                    heading += " · " + row["scenario_run_id"][:12]
                fig.text(.07, y, _wrap(heading, 111), fontsize=8, va="top", linespacing=1.15)
                fig.text(.93, y, str(row["page"]), fontsize=9, va="top", ha="right")
            pdf.savefig(fig, dpi=options["dpi"])
        finally:
            plt.close(fig)


def _index_row(page, number, root, options):
    family = page["family"]
    prefix = family + "-"
    run_id = page["key"][len(prefix):] if page["key"].startswith(prefix) else None
    panels = []
    for panel in page["panels"]:
        panels.append({
            "title": panel["label"], "units": panel["units"],
            "signed": bool(panel.get("signed")), "display_scale": panel.get("scale"),
            "source_raster": Path(panel["path"]).resolve().relative_to(root.resolve()).as_posix(),
        })
    return {
        "page": number, "family": family, "map_key": page["key"],
        "scenario_run_id": run_id,
        "title": options["family_titles"].get(family) or page["title"],
        "subtitle": page["subtitle"], "panels": panels,
        "overlays": [{"label": overlay["label"], "source": overlay.get("source")}
                     for overlay in page["overlays"]],
    }


def _csv(rows):
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    columns = ("atlas_page", "family", "map_key", "scenario_run_id", "title",
               "map_pdf", "panel", "units", "signed", "scale_minimum",
               "scale_maximum", "scale_method", "source_raster")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=columns)
    writer.writeheader()
    for row in rows:
        for panel in row["panels"]:
            scale = panel["display_scale"] or {}
            writer.writerow({
                "atlas_page": row["page"], "family": row["family"], "map_key": row["map_key"],
                "scenario_run_id": row["scenario_run_id"], "title": row["title"],
                "map_pdf": row["file"]["path"], "panel": panel["title"],
                "units": panel["units"], "signed": panel["signed"],
                "scale_minimum": scale.get("minimum"), "scale_maximum": scale.get("maximum"),
                "scale_method": scale.get("label"), "source_raster": panel["source_raster"],
            })
    return output.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig")


def write(directory, pages, *, workspace, selection, grid, boundary, crs,
          footer, state, state_path):
    """Write standalone maps and an ordered atlas from the same rendered figures.

    The caller retains scientific panel selection, overlays and shared scales.
    Retained single maps are verified and reused on resume; their figures are
    rendered again only to reconstruct an interrupted multi-page document.
    """
    options = settings(selection.get("map_settings"))
    pages = list(pages)
    if not pages or len({page["key"] for page in pages}) != len(pages):
        raise ValueError("Atlas map keys must be nonempty and distinct")
    if {page["family"] for page in pages} != set(MAP_IDS):
        raise ValueError("The complete atlas must include all seven original map families")
    order = {family: i for i, family in enumerate(MAP_IDS)}
    pages.sort(key=lambda page: order[page["family"]])  # preserve selected scenario order

    directory = Path(directory)
    if state.get("atlas", {}).get("version") == ATLAS_VERSION and all(
            key in state.get("files", {}) for key in FILE_KEYS):
        for key in FILE_KEYS:
            verify_file(directory, state["files"][key])
        for page in pages:
            verify_file(directory, state["maps"][page["key"]])
        return state["atlas"]

    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.backends.backend_pdf import PdfPages

    index_count = math.ceil(len(pages) / INDEX_ROWS)
    first_map = 2 + index_count
    total = 1 + index_count + len(pages)
    title = options["title"] or selection.get("title") or workspace.project["title"]
    rows = [_index_row(page, first_map + i, workspace.root, options)
            for i, page in enumerate(pages)]
    atlas_path = directory / "maps" / "watershed-map-atlas.pdf"
    pending = directory / "maps" / ".watershed-map-atlas.pending.pdf"
    atlas_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with PdfPages(pending, metadata={
            "Title": title, "Author": selection["contact"]["organization"],
            "Subject": options["subtitle"] or "Seven-family watershed map atlas",
            "Creator": "Upper Savannah Scientific Workbench",
        }) as pdf:
            _intro(pdf, plt, options, rows, title=title, selection=selection,
                   grid=grid, footer=footer, page_count=total)
            for page, row in zip(pages, rows):
                key = page["key"]
                target = directory / "maps" / (key + ".pdf")
                if key in state["maps"]:
                    verify_file(directory, state["maps"][key])
                    single_path = None
                else:
                    single_path = target.with_name("." + target.name)
                subtitle = page["subtitle"]
                if options["subtitle"]:
                    subtitle = options["subtitle"] + " · " + subtitle
                cartography.map_pdf(single_path, row["title"], page["panels"],
                    overlays=page["overlays"], boundary=boundary, crs=crs,
                    subtitle=subtitle, footer=footer, dpi=options["dpi"],
                    paper=options["paper"], project_title=title, pdf_pages=pdf,
                    page_number=row["page"], page_count=total)
                if single_path is not None:
                    single_path.replace(target)
                    state["maps"][key] = describe_file(directory, target)
                    atomic_json(state_path, state)
                row["file"] = state["maps"][key]
            if pdf.get_pagecount() != total:
                raise ValueError("Atlas page count differs from its retained map index")
        pending.replace(atlas_path)
        atlas = {
            "schema": "upstate.map-atlas/v1", "version": ATLAS_VERSION,
            "delivery_id": state["id"], "title": title, "settings": options,
            "pages": rows, "map_count": len(rows), "page_count": total,
            "baseline_run_id": selection["baseline_run_id"],
            "scenario_run_ids": list(selection["scenario_run_ids"]),
            "source_report_id": selection.get("source_report_id"),
            "grid_id": grid["id"], "grid": grid["grid"],
            "file": describe_file(directory, atlas_path),
        }
        index_path = directory / "maps" / "atlas-index.json"
        csv_path = directory / "maps" / "atlas-index.csv"
        atomic_json(index_path, atlas)
        atomic_bytes(csv_path, _csv(rows))
        state["files"]["map_atlas"] = atlas["file"]
        state["files"]["map_atlas_index"] = describe_file(directory, index_path)
        state["files"]["map_atlas_csv"] = describe_file(directory, csv_path)
        state["atlas"] = atlas
        atomic_json(state_path, state)
        return atlas
    finally:
        if pending.exists():
            pending.unlink()

operator/MAP_ATLAS.md.content:
# Seven-family map atlas and complete delivery

The **Map atlas** desk prepares the original complete GIS delivery and opens the retained result in the browser. It adds an ordered PDF atlas, a page catalogue, and print controls to the existing native delivery workflow.

## Prepare a release

Open **Map atlas → Prepare release**.

1. Choose the baseline and the completed land-cover alternatives. The desk checks the original delivery requirements: NDR and SDR are complete, every case uses the baseline grid and profile, and each alternative has an explicit land-cover scenario. Selected cases that need attention remain visible. Move an alternative up or down to set the principal future map and the order of additional scenario sheets.

## Open the result

**Saved releases → Open atlas and files** shows the retained release and its exact file-download tickets.

- **Open complete atlas** previews the single PDF, including cover, contents and every map sheet.
- **Atlas page** jumps to the selected sheet inside that document.
- **Map PDF** opens the original standalone family/scenario PDF.
- **Download JSON index** and **Download CSV index** provide page numbers, exact map keys, run IDs, raster paths, physical units and shared display limits.
- **Download complete GIS package** receives the original full package, including the new atlas/index files and linked saved-report outputs.
- **Revise this selection** opens the complete original selection as a draft, retaining source bindings, receptor settings and other authored delivery extensions.

The required seven families remain the original identifiers in `model.common.MAP_IDS`. The atlas groups each family in that order and preserves the selected alternative order within each future family. There are five baseline/context map sheets plus two sheets per land-cover alternative. The cover and contents pages are additional pages.

## Print settings

All settings live inside the original delivery selection's `map_settings` object.

| Key | Meaning and default |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Printed atlas/study title. Blank uses the delivery title. |
| `subtitle` | Optional explanatory text on the cover and map sheets. |
| `paper` | `a4` (default), `letter`, or `a3`, in landscape orientation. |
| `dpi` | Whole number from 120 to 600; default 220. |
| `family_titles` | Optional title overrides keyed by the seven original family identifiers. |
| `display_percentile` | Exact native-cell display percentile, 0–100; default 98. |
| `weights` | Existing nonnegative pollutant decision weights; at least one positive. |
| `caps` | Existing optional positive pollutant priority caps in the native raster units. |
| `percentile` | Existing priority normalization percentile; the original default remains 95. |

Display scaling uses the current `cartography.shared_display_scale`: separate baseline pollutant scales, and one shared signed scale per pollutant across every future alternative. Each alternative uses the largest of the exact per-raster percentile caps. The combined index retains its fixed 0–1 scale. The renderer receives the existing numerical raster, units, selected overlays and saved scale; it does not recalculate the native models.

Map footers use the current regional delivery's affine-derived cell dimensions. Original NDR/SDR outputs, source-water labels, legal designation semantics, receptor specifications, geographies and report text remain supplied by their existing components. The map atlas records those current titles and source descriptions.

## Retained products and recovery

The existing delivery record gains `atlas` and these three `files` keys:

| Key | Path within the retained delivery |
| --- | --- |
| `map_atlas` | `maps/watershed-map-atlas.pdf` |
| `map_atlas_index` | `maps/atlas-index.json` |
| `map_atlas_csv` | `maps/atlas-index.csv` |

Every standalone map stays in its original `maps/<map-key>.pdf` path and remains under `state.maps`. The delivery's original package manifest includes the atlas products as project assets. The atlas version enters the delivery digest so an existing release remains an immutable earlier edition.

Standalone maps and atlas sheets are saved from the same Matplotlib figure. On resume, completed standalone maps are verified and retained. Figures are rendered again only as needed to reconstruct an interrupted multi-page PDF. The final PDF is replaced atomically after all pages are written; its JSON/CSV indexes record the completed file hash and exact page count.

A resumed GIS package is reused only when its captured manifest matches the current manifest and its retained technical audit passed with no missing references. A changed or failed earlier capture stays available in its original directory; the current release is packaged in a deterministic sibling directory with its own package-hash ZIP. Repeated resume can find and reuse that exact current package.

## Browser integration

The installed `operator/extensions/map-atlas.json` manifest registers the desk through the current extension host. The additions do not require another server route or shared-app dispatcher.

`attachMapAtlas(host)` exposes the ordinary `mount`, `update` and `detach` lifecycle, plus:

```javascript
await host.openExtension('map-atlas', 'create', {
  workspace_key: originWorkspaceKey,
  selection: {
    title: reportTitle,
    baseline_run_id: baselineRunId,
    scenario_run_ids: orderedAlternativeRunIds,
    source_report_id: savedReportId
  }
});

await host.openExtension('map-atlas', 'open', deliveryId, {
  workspace_key: originWorkspaceKey
});
```

`create` also accepts those selection fields directly. It checks the originating workspace before and after asynchronous navigation, preserves every supplied selection field and opens a fresh draft in `map-atlas`. `open` applies the same workspace check around loading and navigation, retrieves the complete retained delivery using `/api/item?kind=deliveries&id=...`, and shows its atlas and downloads. A workspace change rejects the handoff before accepting the other project's cohort. The source-report button returns through `openExtension('scenario-reports', 'open', reportId, {workspace_key})`.

The controller uses `getState`, `api`, `navigate`, `refreshState`, `openItem`, `openExtension`, and `showTask`. Download links use the existing exact-file capability route. Source inspection uses the existing `/api/source-info` route. Actions use the original request shape `{workspace, action, payload, operation_id}`.
